Is there a change on or right around the outlined element in B that a sighted user would notice as showing it has focus? input.changed_pixels counts the pixels that differ, in CSS pixels: on the element, touching it (within 8 pixels of its edge) and elsewhere in the picture. Answer yes, no or unsure, and describe the change in a few plain words.

No: no noticeable change; or the only change is elsewhere in the picture (a slideshow, a video, an animation); or only soft edge pixels around text. Unsure: a pop-up such as a tooltip appears beside the element and nothing on the element changes; or the change is too faint to tell. Answer yes or no only when you are sure.
